subject: SDLC: change-authority ledger & CI credential snapshot for SIG review
messages:
From: Cygnus Security <audit@cygnusassess.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: SDLC artifacts request

Rishi —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of the SIG assessment for FinTechCo we need a compact bundle of artifacts that demonstrate your secure SDLC controls. Can you provide the following by EOD next Tuesday (May 27)?

- Change authority ledger (who approved PRs/merges for the past 90 days) — preferably a CSV or spreadsheet.
- Representative CI run snapshot showing runner identity, masked credentials, and the approval step for a deploy (redacted where necessary).
- Evidence of ephemeral credential rotation (KMS/HSM logs or rotation tickets).
- Short note on how secrets are provisioned to runners (brief steps is fine).

If some items are hosted in a secure Drive or ticketing system, a link is fine but please ensure the assessor has view access or include export attachments.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Assessor, Cygnus Security

Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (1 page checklist)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Cygnus Security <audit@cygnusassess.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SDLC artifacts request

Alex —

Thanks, we can get this over. A few clarifying items so we scope exports correctly:

1) Change authority ledger — do you need a machine-readable export (columns: PR, author, approver, approval_timestamp, merge_commit) or is a filtered spreadsheet OK? We can provide both if helpful.
2) For the CI snapshot, we redact secrets. Do you require the raw env names or fully redacted values? We typically provide runner identity + masked env names + step logs.
3) Rotation proof: we can provide KMS rotation event IDs and the associated ticket links (INFRA-937) or an exported PDF of the KMS audit. Which is preferred?

Plan: Irene will pull the ledger and the CI run snapshot; Marissa will prepare the KMS/ticket evidence. We aim to share a Drive folder with redacted attachments and a CSV export by Friday COB, earlier if possible.

Rishi
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
Rishi
(" , note: contact for any access issues: security-ops@redwood.ai")

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Cygnus Security <audit@cygnusassess.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: SDLC artifacts: change ledger + CI snapshot (initial drop)

Alex / team —

Attached is an initial drop of artifacts for the SIG review. Summary below and notes on redactions.

Attachments (shared to the assessor Drive folder and included as exports):
- sdlc_change_ledger.csv — columns: pr_id, repo, author, approver, approval_ts, merge_commit, change_type. Export covers 2025-02-01 to 2025-05-20.
- ci_run_snapshot_redacted.txt — single-run export for pipeline "deploy-prod" (runner: prod-runner-12). Secrets are masked as <REDACTED>. Shows step that requires two approvers for production deploy. Run ID: run-20250519-047.
- kms_rotation_audit.pdf — redacted view of the KMS rotation events for key "deploy-secrets-key" for the past 6 months (event IDs included, last rotation: 2025-05-14).

Notes:
- Change authority: our policy requires at least one code review approval and a merge owner sign-off for protected branches. The ledger includes a "change_type" tag (bugfix/feature/hotfix).
- Secrets provisioning: runners fetch short-lived credentials from Vault (HashiCorp Vault) via a signed role exchange. Tokens expire in 5 minutes; the CI orchestrator refreshes tokens on each job. We captured a brief snippet in the CI snapshot showing the STS exchange (values redacted).
- Tickets: relevant ticket for the rotation is INFRA-937 (link included in Drive).

If you need a larger time window for the ledger or raw job logs with sanitized tokens, let us know and we can produce an export under a secured share.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: sdlc_change_ledger.csv (CSV), ci_run_snapshot_redacted.txt (text), kms_rotation_audit.pdf (PDF)

From: Cygnus Security <audit@cygnusassess.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Tue, 27 May 2025 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC artifacts: change ledger + CI snapshot (initial drop)

Irene / Rishi —

Received, thanks for the prompt delivery. Quick follow-ups after a brief review:

- The ledger CSV looks good; we saw the change_type column which is helpful. Can you include the approver's role (e.g., "team-lead", "platform-owner") for approvers who are not individual accounts (some approvals show as service-accounts)?
- For the CI snapshot: we need one additional run where an automatic fallback kicked in (runner re-route). If you have run-20250402-011 or similar with a fallback trace, please include that.
- Rotation proof: the KMS PDF shows event IDs — can you also provide the rotation ticket notes (INFRA-937 link wasn't accessible due to permissions). If a read-only export isn't possible, a short pasted chronology with event IDs and timestamps is acceptable.

If you can push the updated CSV and the additional run log into the same Drive folder by EOD Thursday, that should keep us on track. Otherwise we'll ask for a 48-hour extension.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Assessor, Cygnus Security
